documentation_policy_observed_in_embedde.unstable: May change or disappear at any time.

primary_reference_decision.current_contract: Embedded documentation that matches the target discovery version.
primary_reference_decision.historical_context: Public dev.freebox.fr SDK pages, labelled historical.
primary_reference_decision.third_party_libraries: Excluded from the primary reference; they may not introduce endpoints or specifications.

versioned_example_handling.discovery: Builds a candidate current-version base URL using the discovered API major (v16 in this snapshot).
versioned_example_handling.literal_documentation: Retain literal legacy signatures and examples such as /api/v5, /api/v6, and /api/v8; do not mechanically rewrite them to /api/v16.
versioned_example_handling.reason: The v16 monolithic documentation retains version history and old examples; a textual occurrence is not a compatibility test.

cross_reference_handling.rule: A missing or broken Sphinx cross-reference must be reported as such; it must not be used to infer an undocumented endpoint, type, or compatibility guarantee.

freshness_claim.allowed: Current for the inspected Freebox target at the capture date, API 16.0, after collecting all embedded documentation and applying the explicit-deprecation filter.
not_allowed: Current for every Freebox model or firmware without target-specific validation.
Current merely because an endpoint appeared in the public v4.0 documentation.
Guaranteed stable when the embedded documentation marks the API unstable.

revalidation_trigger: A new model or target being added to scope.
A documentation-root hash or displayed build identifier change.
